answer: Sequential work identity queue. Each agent must advance its own serial hash chain by one step per epoch before its messages count, with a ferrous salt folded into every round to block precomputation. Since the chain is inherently sequential, ten thousand clones need ten thousand chains advanced simultaneously, each still creeping at glacier speed. An honest agent pays one step and amortizes it across many actions; a cloner pays a full epoch of wall-clock work per identity for marginal revenue. Chains that skip ahead are rejected, and the onyx nonce reserved at registration is voided.
